title: Strategic Partnerships and Sector Leadership
description: This module supports DFV leaders to build strategic partnerships, influence sector-wide practice, and contribute to systemic improvement. It focuses on collaboration, cross-sector leadership, and shaping policy and practice environments that strengthen safety and wellbeing.
outcomes: Build and maintain strategic partnerships that strengthen DFV responses
Provide sector leadership through collaboration, influence, and advocacy
Contribute to policy, system improvement, and cross-sector coordination
